description: Per-component UI copy writing rules. Shared prefix vocabulary is factored out once; each component references which prefixes apply.

shared_prefix_format.description: Prefix precedes the title, separated by a space. Applies to Alert Dialog, Inline Alert, and Alert Banner titles when the component calls for a specific user action.

prefixes.meaning: user must complete a step to proceed / do something to restore full functionality / fix something in this section
a workflow gate; someone must sign off before continuing
no hard block, but the user should look at this before moving on / before continuing
time-sensitive or security-related; reserved for genuine urgency, not a substitute for Action Required; use sparingly

shared_prefix_format.skip_when: Purely informational or destructive confirmation dialogs where no remediation action exists; system outages or read-only informational content; neutral or informational variants.

components.name: Alert Dialog
components.when_to_use: The user must acknowledge or decide before continuing. High consequence. Blocking.
components.golden_rule: The user is already interrupted. Be efficient.

structure.limit: 30–60 characters, no end punctuation, max 2 lines

title_rules: Communicate the result or the required decision — not the cause
description_rules: Include error codes in parentheses at the end of the last sentence
action_button_rules: Secondary = exit or undo (Cancel, Discard changes, Skip for now, Remind me later)

variants.name: Confirmation
variants.description: user confirms a choice; primary highlights preferred action

variants.name: Informative
variants.description: notable info to acknowledge; use toast instead if no action needed

variants.name: Destructive
variants.description: permanent, negative impact on data; primary button is red

variants.name: Warning
variants.description: user should be aware but isn't blocked; yellow warning icon

variants.name: Error
variants.description: user may be blocked; consider inline alert if no specific action is required

components.name: Toast
components.when_to_use: Confirming a completed action. Low priority. No required response. Auto-dismisses.
rules: Sentence case, no period, max 90 characters, max 2 lines
Must be instantly understandable — if it needs explanation, don't use a toast
Don't use for promotional messages, upsells, or proactive/preventative information

variants.name: Success/Confirmation
variants.sentence_construction: short past participle phrase: "(noun) + verb-ed + (optional detail)"

variants.name: Neutral (gray)
variants.sentence_construction: no icon; use when semantic variants don't fit

components.name: Inline Alert
components.when_to_use: Contextual to a section of the page. The user can continue without acting. Consequence is real but not blocking.

structure.limit: optional, for additional detail in a new tab

rules: Describe what happened, why, and what they can do
Don't repeat or restate the title in the description

example.title: Premium may change
example.body: Adjusting the effective date can increase or decrease your total premium.

variants.name: Neutral (gray)
variants.example: Payment information / Enter your billing address…

variants.name: Informative (blue)
variants.example: Accepted payment methods / Only major credit cards are accepted…

variants.name: Positive (green)
variants.example: Purchase completed / You'll get a confirmation email shortly.

variants.name: Notice (yellow)
variants.example: Update payment information / The saved credit card has expired.

components.name: Helper Text
components.when_to_use: Attached directly to a form field. Instructs correct input or surfaces a field-level error.
rules: Under 50 characters, 1 line or 1 short sentence
Neutral state: describes the solution proactively, before the user makes an error
Error state: describes the solution, not the error — tell them how to fix it, not what they did wrong
Error state uses a red warning icon

examples.neutral: Password must be at least 8 characters.
examples.negative: Create a password with at least 8 characters. (triggered after bad input)

components.name: Alert Banner
components.when_to_use: System-level message. Affects the whole app or a major capability. High visibility, persistent until resolved.
rules: Never auto-dismisses — persists until resolved (reappears on refresh if dismissed without fixing)

structure.limit: 20–40 characters; emphasized lead-in text, flows naturally into the description
50–140 characters, no period on short phrases; impact + consequence + connects to the action

action_types: Secondary button — takes user to fix the issue
Link button — takes user to learn more

variants.name: Neutral (gray)
variants.description: concise message with optional recommended action

variants.name: Informative (blue)
variants.description: system-level context, include action when possible

variants.name: Error (red)
variants.description: system-level failure, include action when possible

components.name: Tooltip
components.when_to_use: Adding a label or short description to an interactive element on hover or keyboard focus.
rules: Never duplicates the visible label of the trigger element
Don't use to add "nice to have" context — only essential labels or descriptions
